mapper.select: select po.id, po.customer_id, po.process_id, order_date, product_name, spec_1, spec_2, special_unit_price, po.remark, po.create_time, po.update_time, c.name customer_name, p.name process_name, cp.fake_unit_price unit_price from biz_prepare_order po left join biz_customer c on po.customer_id = c.id left join biz_process p on po.process_id = p.id left join biz_customer_process_price cp on po.customer_id = cp.customer_id and po.process_id = cp.process_id order by po.customer_id, po.id
